name: provenant-dashboard
description: Source for the Provenant dashboard. `npm run build` writes the bundle to ../dashboard; the server needs no Node at runtime.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.jsx --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --jsx=automatic --loader:.js=jsx --legal-comments=linked --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --outfile=../dashboard/app.js && esbuild src/GetStarted.jsx --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --jsx=automatic --loader:.js=jsx --legal-comments=linked --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --outfile=../dashboard/start.js && esbuild src/Site.jsx --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --jsx=automatic --loader:.js=jsx --legal-comments=linked --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --outfile=../dashboard/site.js
